reply: Client onboarding is the process of understanding your business, project goals, requirements and expectations before work begins. OnboardFlow makes this process easier through guided questions and a structured project brief.

Nexa Digital Studio offers:

1. Website Development
2. E-commerce Development
3. UI/UX Design
4. Graphic Design
5. SEO Services
6. Social Media Management
7. Website Maintenance

Would you like details about a particular service?
Our Website Development service focuses on responsive, modern and user-friendly websites. We can discuss business websites, landing pages and custom website requirements.
Our E-commerce Development service focuses on online stores, product displays, shopping experiences and essential store functionality.
UI/UX Design focuses on making websites and applications visually appealing, easy to navigate and comfortable to use.
Our Graphic Design service covers visual identity, logo concepts, marketing graphics and other creative design requirements.
SEO helps improve a website's visibility in search engines through appropriate optimization strategies and content improvements.
Social Media Management helps businesses plan and manage their online presence, content and social media communication.
Website Maintenance covers ongoing updates, technical improvements and website support according to the agreed project requirements.
Every project has different requirements. Pricing depends on the selected service, functionality, complexity and delivery expectations. Submit your project brief to discuss a suitable quotation.
Payment arrangements would be discussed and agreed before a project begins. The appropriate terms depend on the project scope.
Project timelines depend on the complexity, required features and scope of work. You can share your preferred completion timeframe in the onboarding form.
Revision arrangements depend on the agreed project scope. We recommend discussing revision expectations before work begins.
To understand your project, we generally need your contact details, business information, selected service, project description, target audience, budget and preferred timeline.

Our proposed workflow is:

1. Understand your requirements.
2. Review your project brief.
3. Discuss the scope and quotation.
4. Agree on project terms.
5. Begin the project.
6. Complete delivery and agreed support.
Deliverables depend on your selected service and project agreement. The handover process and required files will be discussed before project completion.
Post-project support arrangements depend on the agreed terms. Website maintenance can also be discussed for ongoing technical requirements.
Nexa Digital Studio is a fictional agency used for this demonstration project. No real contact details or actual service commitments are associated with it.
